title: Her back patio, morning sun (The Epilogue, CTA)
imagePrompt:
A single frame from a finished 3D animated feature film, rendered through a virtual camera emulating a large-format sensor with spherical primes with a 24mm lens and deep focus, the whole set sharp, 24 frames per second with a 180-degree shutter, the camera placed and moved by a layout artist who framed this moment on purpose. A final render from the film, not concept art, not a storyboard, not a game and not a toy, composed as a wide 16:9 location plate with no letterbox bars.

Image 1 is the property reference. This room is part of THE SAME HOUSE as the attached property reference image — the faded sand walls, white baseboards, rounded stucco archways, white flat-panel doors with nickel levers, terracotta floor tiles turning to oatmeal carpet in the bedroom — the same finishes throughout, seen here at the back of that same house, outdoors, with nothing redecorated and nothing newer than the rest.

A single rendered frame of the back patio of a 1990s single-storey stucco ranch house in a quiet suburb of Phoenix, Arizona, lived in by the same woman for thirty years, from standing eye level under the edge of the patio cover looking out across it: terracotta tiles, a round wrought-iron table with a mosaic top and two cushioned wrought-iron chairs in the middle; a sand-coloured stucco garden wall at the back, covered on the RIGHT with magenta bougainvillea; tall terracotta pots with an agave and a lemon tree on the LEFT; a small desert garden of round cacti and gravel beyond the table; a string of unlit bulbs along the patio beam overhead; a blue sky above the wall. AN EMPTY LOCATION PLATE: nobody in frame, nothing held. NO WRITING ANYWHERE IN THE FRAME: no readable lettering, numbers, logos or signage on any surface, package, sign or screen.

THE LIGHT IS DESIGNED AND MOTIVATED BY the low morning sun over the garden wall ON frame left. The key is warm and clear in golden 4300K, shaping every face with a clear lit side and a shadow side. A fill in cool sky-blue bounce from the open sky comes from the opposite side at about a quarter of the key, and a rim separates each character from the background. The background carries its own practicals and bounce light. Every light in frame has a source you could point to. Morning: long soft shadows of the chairs across the tiles toward the camera, the bougainvillea glowing where the sun catches it, the patio cover's shade at the bottom of the frame.

THE LOOK OF THIS FILM: A warm, grown-up American animated family drama made like a theatrical 3D feature — a bright big-box store aisle, a lamplit family living room, a bedroom vanity and a sunlit patio, told with tenderness and quiet wit. Appealing stylised adults about five and a half to six heads tall, each built on one clear shape, large expressive eyes, soft rounded features and simple readable hands. Soft subsurface skin with no pores, sculpted groomed hair that catches the light in strands, fabric with real weave and weight, and surfaces with a light painterly softness. Bright clean whites, cool blues and warm wood in the store; amber lamplight, dusty mauve and faded grey in the house of the Before; soft lilac, cream, camel and warm gold in the After. Rendered with natural, balanced colour, ungraded — the grade is added later in the edit. Every frame of this film shares exactly this look.

RENDER. A final-quality feature render. Light bounces colour between surfaces, skin and ears glow softly where light passes through them, hair is groomed and catches the light strand by strand, fabric has real weave and weight, and shadows are soft and motivated, with contact shadow wherever two things touch. The virtual lens gives a soft depth of field behind the subject, and edges are clean. Stylized but fully rendered: every surface has a material, and nothing is flat, unlit or unfinished.
